floruit.note: saint.gr: «Οι Όσιοι Ισαάκ, Κλήμης, Κύριλλος, Νικήτας και Νικηφόρος Αλφάνωφ ήσαν αδελφοί και έζησαν κατά τον 14ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στο Νόβγκοροντ. Το 1389 ίδρυσαν το μοναστήρι του Σοκολνίτσκι.» The page gives no year of birth or of death for any of the five.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and enumerates five brothers by name, so this is one of five folders. **He is none of the corpus's other Clements** — of Rome, of Ancyra, of Ohrid, of Sardis, of Mount Sagmation, or the Studite hymnographer whose Greek row was written for 30 Απριλίου four days before this one — and the surname in the display name is what tells him from them. The page gives the five a **second fixed day**, «Η μνήμη τους τιμάται, επίσης, στις 17 Ιουνίου», which is recorded here and not given a row of its own. The surname is stored only in the display name because the page prints it in Greek letters alone. No year, no hymn, no separate word about him.
